LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: Rediscover Halloween in this imaginative RPG from Tim Schafer's Double Fine Productions.  Explore the monster-filled neighborhood of Auburn Pines, Autumn Haven Mall and Fall Valley Carnival. Collect magical costumes with super powers, unique weapons and special items as you hunt down quests.  Level-up your heroic warrior and battle the evil overlords in this epic adventure to save Halloween!  Sweet info at www. CostumeQuestGame.com
